verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for any product with documentation, including a terminal emulator, so the axis applies. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at alacritty.org/llms.txt), and nothing in the pack shows agent-oriented docs; the standard human-facing config and feature docs do not qualify.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
